newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Eight Indonesians die while mountain climbing.
newsitem.headline: Eight Indonesians die while mountain climbing.

text.p: Eight Indonesians have died from bad weather and freezing temperatures high on Mount Rinjani on the eastern island of Lombok, the Antara news agency reported on Tuesday.
The victims, two of whom were still missing, died Saturday and Sunday as they were descending the 3,726-metre (12,420-feet) peak on Lombok, east of Bali, it said.
Antara said the victims, five who were aged between 50 and 60 years, climbed the mountain to bathe in hot springs there that are thought to cure various diseases.

"It seems they died because of the storm, rain and the freezing temperatures of between 10 and 16 degrees Celcius, which usually lasts from January through March each year," said a village official near the mountain.
Antara said one victim had been evacuated from the mountain and the search for the others was continuing, but gave no other details.
The climb up Rinjani, a dormant volcano, is popular with foreign tourists as it is regarded one of the most scenic climbs of Indonesia's many volcanic mountains.
